values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/agda-purifier'
agda-purifier lock
agda Main.agda
values.language_tooling_setup: Use the supplied `agda` wrapper for `agda --interaction` or `agda --interaction-json`. It selects the prepared library registry and readonly Nix dependency sources and interfaces. The project keeps mutable interfaces in `_build/`. This is Agda’s native editor protocol, rather than LSP.
